title: Power Apps: modern, refreshed look reaches the mail app on the semi-annual channel
summary: The briefing's rollout facts, default, licensing requirement and release-channel API are supported. Minor corrections should complete the setting path, acknowledge a documented channel exception and remove a checklist instruction for a control absent from the table. The cited documentation is accessible; the pre-check's fetch failures did not establish broken links.
